criterion_bindings.exemption: The historical-tier join is deferred with the pruning mechanism by CD-0066, so no live population exercises it. The watermark law it will depend on is proved by TestRebuildKnowledgeIndexAndQ9Q10UseCurrentGitHead (internal/store/knowledge_index_test.go).
Pack cleanup gating is an operation property. The guarantee is proved by TestTerminalResearchCleanupRefusesRequiredCompaction (internal/store/research_test.go).

Pack deletion atomicity is an operation property. The guarantee is proved by TestTerminalResearchCleanupDeletesUnblockedPack and TestInterruptedTerminalCleanupFinishesAtNextPackMutation (internal/store/research_test.go).

Historical projection derivation is a rebuild property. The guarantee is proved by TestCompactionPayloadRequiresExplicitUniqueScopeArrays and TestUpcastCompactionLinkPublishedV1PreservesLegacyBytesAndOrder (internal/store/knowledge_index_test.go).

summary: Defines bounded projection retention and git-rebuildable historical indexing.
title: Compaction retention policy
